nodes.label: R11 Governed BOQ-to-Draft-Quotation Golden Run (Al Mousa School)
ENG-AUTH-1 Authorization Honesty (Technical Reviewer gate is a business requirement, not server-enforced)
nodes.rationale: `worker/application-context.mjs` grants fullAccess:true and role Administrator in single-user mode and `library-auth.mjs` returns no denial whenever fullAccess is set, so the server cannot independently discriminate the Technical Reviewer role in this deployment. No role was impersonated: selecting a product family or recording a review on an engineer's behalf would fabricate an engineering decision and would be indistinguishable in the audit trail from a real one.

nodes.label: Governed Profile Generation Step (POST requirement-profile/generate)
nodes.rationale: One trial item first to confirm the governed outcome before scaling; the trial returned Needs Technical Review with approved_for_matching = 0 — fail-closed, as required — then 80 remaining items dispatched. No profile self-approved.

nodes.label: Three Independent Human Gates Open at R11 Stop
nodes.rationale: Classification Required items rest on unreviewed AI INFERRED families that the engine correctly refuses to treat as authoritative; approve-readiness refuses unless readiness_status === 'Ready for Matching'; and the AIU review gate is untouched. Drawing architecture approval also fails closed with 0 approved rows because topology must not be invented.
